items.description: Declares `@williamthorsen/nmr` as a `workspace:*` devDependency of every workspace package but nmr and nmr-core, so that pnpm builds nmr first and a package's build cannot load `packages/nmr/dist` while nmr is replacing it, and adds a root unit test that fails when a package omits the declaration. (#1302)

Drops `--conditions nmr-source` from the `prepare` scripts of `build-info`, `build-info-react`, and `change-grammar`, which pnpm now runs after nmr-core is built because each package depends on nmr-core through nmr. (#1302)
Renames the `readGit` option of `collectBuildInfo` and `buildInfoPlugin` to `shouldReadGit`, following the package's convention for boolean options, such as `shouldShowEnvironment`. (#1232)
items.migration: Replace `readGit` with `shouldReadGit` in the options passed to `collectBuildInfo` or `buildInfoPlugin`, because both functions now ignore a leftover `readGit: false` and run git.

items.description: Fixes the issue that `readReleaseNotes` and `collectBuildInfo` in `@williamthorsen/build-info` returned empty release notes without any error when `CHANGELOG.md` or `.meta/changelog.json` existed but could not be read, such as a file without read permission or a directory at that path; both now throw the read error and treat only a missing changelog as absent. (#1234)

Moves `isRecord` and `compactRecord` from `src/collect/portable` to `src/portable` in `build-info`, which lets `contract/normalize.ts` import `isRecord` within the lint boundary that excludes `collect` and drop its duplicate copy. (#1229)
Narrows the `try` blocks in `readEventPayload` and `parseUrl` to the calls that can throw, and moves the `isRecord` and hostname checks after the `catch`. (#1230)
Extracts `collectBuildInfoWith`, which takes the git reader as a parameter, from `collectBuildInfo` so that its unit tests pass a fake reader instead of mocking `readGitFacts` with `vi.mock`. (#1233)

Moves `readReleaseNotes.ts` and its unit test into `packages/build-info/src/collect/sources/`, beside the other sources that `collectBuildInfo` reads, while `./collect` keeps the same exports. (#1235)
Moves the Vite plugin test to the `tool` tier by renaming it to `buildInfoPlugin.tool.test.ts`, because the test makes Vite run a library build in-process. (#1231)

Adds an optional `BuildLabelOptions` argument to `formatBuildLabel`, whose `shouldShowEnvironment` flag appends the build's environment as the label's last segment, and adds `environment` to the segments returned by `getBuildLabelParts`. (#1093)
Rewrites the code that the new and widened rules in `eslint-plugin-unicorn` 78 report, mostly by changing `flatMap` callbacks to return a single value rather than a one-element array. (#1072)

Upgrades `@williamthorsen/eslint-config-typescript` from 18.0.0 to 19.0.0 and rewrites the code in `build-info`, `nmr-core`, `nmr`, and `release-kit` that its new and widened rules report, without changing behavior. (#1047)

Upgrades `pnpm` to 12.11.2, `@types/node` to 24.19.2, `lefthook` to 2.2.1, `@williamthorsen/strict-lint` to 14.2.0, `@williamthorsen/tsconfig` to 0.11.0, `smol-toml` to 1.9.1, and `vite` to 8.3.4. (#1047)
Moves the `lint-boundary` tests of `build-info` and `change-grammar` from the `unit` tier to `tool`, because they run ESLint. (#1037)

Adds `collectBuildInfo` as the new `@williamthorsen/build-info/collect` subpath, a synchronous call that any config file can make, which returns the app's `BuildInfo` from its `package.json`, its changelog, the environment variables of Vercel, EAS Build, or GitHub Actions, and git. (#987)

Adds `readReleaseNotes` to `@williamthorsen/build-info/collect`, which returns the public release notes of every version, newest first, from `.meta/changelog.json` or, when that file is missing or malformed, from `CHANGELOG.md`. (#987)

Adds the Vite plugin `buildInfoPlugin` as the `@williamthorsen/build-info/vite` subpath, which defines `__BUILD_INFO__` as the collected `BuildInfo` and writes it to `build-info.json` in the output directory, and declares Vite 8 as an optional peer dependency. (#987)

Adds `getBuildLabelParts` to `@williamthorsen/build-info`, which returns the segments of the label that `formatBuildLabel` produces (the version, short SHA, and build time), for a renderer that marks up each segment on its own. (#988)
Adds `@williamthorsen/build-info`, an initially empty package that will describe which build an app is: its version, commit, build time, environment, and release notes. (#983)

Adds the `BuildInfo` type with `parseBuildInfo`, `isBuildInfo`, and `serializeBuildInfo`, which check a value against it, and `InvalidBuildInfoError`, which names the first invalid field when parsing or serializing fails. (#985)

Adds `formatBuildLabel`, which formats a one-line label such as `v0.7.0 · a59f2f8 · 2026-10-08 06:29Z`, and `getCommitUrl`, which returns the URL of the build's commit when its repository is on GitHub. (#985)
